# diagrams

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-001 — Mermaid fences and directives become diagram figures](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-001.md) — When a document contains a mermaid fence or a {mermaid} directive, the extension SHALL render a figure whose diagram element is labelled "Mermaid diagram" and holds the diagram text for the page to draw, with the same text in a collapsed "Diagram source" disclosure.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-002 — The Mermaid renderer loads only when a Mermaid figure exists](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-002.md) — When the rendered content contains a Mermaid figure, the extension SHALL add the Mermaid renderer script from its bundle to the page with the page's script nonce, and SHALL add no Mermaid script when the content has none.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-003 — Mermaid diagrams are drawn as inert pictures](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-003.md) — When the page draws a Mermaid diagram, it SHALL replace the diagram text with one image whose alt text is "Mermaid diagram" and whose source is a data URI of the SVG drawn at the strict security level, and SHALL set data-render-state to rendered.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-004 — Mermaid pictures keep their natural size within the content width](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-004.md) — When a Mermaid picture is wider than the content column, the extension SHALL scale it down to the column width keeping its proportions, and SHALL NOT enlarge a picture that is narrower.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-005 — Mermaid colours come from the preview theme variables](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-005.md) — When the page draws a Mermaid diagram, it SHALL set the node fill from --studio-textCodeBlock-background, the text and line colours from --studio-editor-foreground, the border colour from --sphinx-preview-border, the secondary and tertiary colours from --studio-textBlockQuote-background and --studio-editor-background, the font from --sphinx-preview-font, and a transparent diagram background.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-006 — Mermaid diagrams are drawn again when the theme changes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-006.md) — When the data-sphinx-preview-theme-mode, data-sphinx-preview-theme, class or style attribute of the html element, or the class or style attribute of the body element, changes, the page SHALL check every Mermaid diagram and draw again each one whose theme colours differ from those it was drawn with, keeping the labels.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-007 — Mermaid falls back to built-in colours](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-007.md) — When a Mermaid theme variable is missing, empty or a CSS system colour keyword such as Canvas, the page SHALL use the built-in fallback for it: #f0f0f0, #1f1f1f, #808080, #ffffff or the sans-serif font.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-008 — Mermaid edge labels stay readable](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-008.md) — When a Mermaid map with edge labels is drawn in the dark, light or fallback theme, the extension SHALL keep every edge label in the picture with a text contrast of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-009 — Unchanged Mermaid diagrams are not drawn again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-009.md) — When the page needs a Mermaid diagram whose source and theme colours equal those of an earlier drawing, it SHALL show that drawing without running Mermaid again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-010 — The Mermaid drawing cache keeps 64 drawings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-010.md) — When more than 64 distinct Mermaid drawings have been stored, the page SHALL discard the least recently used drawing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-011 — A content patch draws only Mermaid diagrams not yet drawn](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-011.md) — When the preview content is patched in place, the page SHALL draw the Mermaid diagrams that have no render state and SHALL leave the diagrams that have one untouched.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-012 — Mermaid draw passes run one at a time](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-012.md) — When several Mermaid draw passes are requested, the page SHALL run them one after another, each pass waiting for the Mermaid module to load and for the previous pass to finish.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-013 — Mermaid element ids stay unique for the page life](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-013.md) — When the page asks Mermaid to draw a diagram, it SHALL give the drawing an element id made of a counter that never repeats during the life of the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-014 — A late Mermaid result for a replaced theme is not shown](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-014.md) — When Mermaid finishes a drawing after a newer pass planned the same node for another key, the page SHALL keep that drawing in the cache and show only the drawing of the node's current key.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-015 — Invalid Mermaid syntax shows one message with the parser reason](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-015.md) — When Mermaid cannot draw a diagram, the page SHALL insert at the top of the diagram element the message "Unable to render Mermaid diagram. Its source remains available below." followed by a collapsed "Show the parser error" section holding the parser's reason as plain text, and SHALL set data-render-state to error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-016 — An invalid Mermaid diagram keeps exactly one error](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-016.md) — When a Mermaid diagram that cannot be drawn is drawn again, the page SHALL replace the earlier error with the new one so that the diagram holds exactly one error message and one parser details section.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-017 — Mermaid inserts a starter flowchart](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-017.md) — When a writer picks the Mermaid action of the edition palette or the Mermaid slash entry, the extension SHALL insert a fenced mermaid block with a top-down flowchart from a node labelled Start to a node labelled End, set apart from the text around it and placed after the selection, with the label Start selected.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-018 — Mermaid is offered in the GFM palette mode only](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-018.md) — When the edition palette or the slash menu is in GFM mode, the extension SHALL offer a Mermaid action in the GitHub group with the tooltip "Mermaid diagram" and the slash aliases diagram, chart, graph and flowchart, and SHALL NOT offer it in the other palette modes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-019 — Comment quotes are never wrapped inside diagrams](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-019.md) — When a review thread anchor falls inside a Mermaid or PlantUML figure, the page SHALL NOT wrap text of that figure in a comment quote.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-020 — Selecting text inside a diagram offers no comment](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-020.md) — When the selection of a writer lies inside a Mermaid or PlantUML figure, the page SHALL NOT offer to create a review comment for it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-021 — Diagrams can use the wider column in Auto width](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-021.md) — When the width mode is Auto and a Mermaid diagram or a diagram figure is wider than the text column, the page SHALL mark it wide so it can use the available width, unless the diagram is being edited.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-022 — A diagram under edit is hidden](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-022.md) — When a block editor is open on a diagram block, the page SHALL hide the rendered block with display none and show the editor after it, and SHALL show the block again when the editor closes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-023 — PlantUML fences and directives become diagram figures](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-023.md) — When a document contains a plantuml fence, or a {plantuml} or {uml} directive with a body, the extension SHALL render a figure whose diagram element is labelled "PlantUML diagram" and holds the diagram text for the engine, with the same text in a collapsed "Diagram source" disclosure.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-024 — The useJar setting chooses the PlantUML engine](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-024.md) — When the setting markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.useJar is not exactly true, the extension SHALL draw PlantUML diagrams with the built-in engine, and when it is true in a trusted workspace SHALL select the JAR pipeline.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-025 — useJar in an untrusted workspace keeps the JAR pipeline](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-025.md) — When useJar is true in an untrusted workspace, the extension SHALL still select the JAR pipeline, which refuses to start a process, and SHALL NOT fall back to the built-in engine.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-026 — The built-in engine starts no process](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-026.md) — When PlantUML diagrams are drawn by the built-in engine, the extension SHALL start no process and read no PlantUML executable or JAR, whether the workspace is trusted or not.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-027 — jarPath is ignored until useJar is on](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-027.md) — While useJar is not true, the extension SHALL ignore markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath and keep its value for later use.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-028 — The built-in PlantUML script loads only when needed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-028.md) — When the engine is the built-in one and the rendered content contains a PlantUML figure, the extension SHALL add the built-in engine script from its bundle to the page with the page's script nonce, and SHALL add it in no other case.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-029 — Built-in PlantUML diagrams are drawn as inert pictures](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-029.md) — When the built-in engine draws a diagram, the page SHALL replace the diagram text with one image whose alt text is "PlantUML diagram" and whose source is a data URI of the SVG, and SHALL set data-render-state to rendered.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-030 — Built-in diagrams follow the light or dark preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-030.md) — When the preview background is dark, the page SHALL ask the built-in engine for the dark rendering, and otherwise for the light rendering.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-031 — The built-in engine needs nothing outside the extension](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-031.md) — When the built-in engine draws a diagram that uses a bundled theme, an OpenIconic sprite or a class-like layout, the extension SHALL need no network access and no Graphviz installation, using PlantUML's own Smetana layout.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-032 — Diagrams that need a URL or a library are refused with a message](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-032.md) — When a built-in diagram has a line starting with !includeurl, !includedef or !import, an include of a URL or of a library name in angle brackets, or a !theme with from, the page SHALL show one message naming the directive and its line and the useJar hint instead of a picture, and SHALL set data-render-state to unavailable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-033 — The library loaders of the built-in engine refuse every request](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-033.md) — When the built-in engine asks for a standard-library bundle or an optional script such as emoji, the page SHALL refuse the request with an error and SHALL NOT add a script tag or fetch anything.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-034 — The file loader refuses local files without a render or a host](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-034.md) — When the built-in engine asks for a local file outside a render or when the page has no host connection, the page SHALL refuse the request with a reason that names the file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-035 — A theme read from a folder is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-035.md) — When the built-in engine asks for a !theme read from a folder or a URL, the page SHALL refuse it even if the pre-scan did not catch the directive, and the diagram SHALL show the include failure message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-036 — Unsupported directives inside included files name the file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-036.md) — When a local file read for the built-in engine contains a directive that needs a URL or a library, the diagram SHALL show the unavailable message naming the directive, its line, the file name and the useJar hint.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-037 — A built-in engine failure shows its reason](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-037.md) — When the built-in engine reports an error or throws, the page SHALL show "The built-in PlantUML engine could not render this diagram: " followed by the reason as plain text without a leading Java-style class name and the useJar hint, show no picture, and set data-render-state to error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-038 — The built-in engine refuses a source over 1 MiB](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-038.md) — When the text of a built-in diagram is longer than 1 MiB (1,048,576 characters), the page SHALL show "The PlantUML source exceeds the 1 MiB preview limit." without running the engine and set data-render-state to unavailable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-039 — Built-in pictures are kept by source, base and variant](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-039.md) — When the page needs a built-in diagram whose source, include base and light or dark variant equal those of an earlier result, it SHALL show that result without running the engine.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-040 — The built-in result cache keeps 64 results](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-040.md) — When the page has stored more than 64 built-in results, it SHALL drop the least recently used result.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-041 — Results with refused includes are not kept](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-041.md) — When a built-in render ends with a refused include or an included file holding an unsupported directive, the page SHALL NOT keep the result, so the next render asks again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-042 — The built-in engine draws one diagram at a time](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-042.md) — When several built-in diagrams need drawing, the page SHALL run the engine for one diagram at a time in the order requested.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-043 — A superseded built-in render does not overwrite a newer one](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-043.md) — When a newer render of the same diagram element starts before an earlier one finishes, the page SHALL show only the result of the newer render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-044 — A content patch draws only new built-in diagrams](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-044.md) — When the preview content is patched in place, the page SHALL draw the built-in diagrams that have no render state and SHALL leave the others untouched.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-045 — A changed included file redraws the diagrams that read files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-045.md) — When the page learns that an included file changed, it SHALL forget the kept results that read files and draw again the diagrams marked data-plantuml-includes true and those still drawing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-046 — Local includes are read through the extension](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-046.md) — When a built-in diagram contains !include, !include_many, !include_once or !includesub of a local file, the page SHALL ask the extension host for the file with a previewPlantUmlInclude message and draw the diagram with the text returned, making no network request.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-047 — Include answers are matched by their edit id](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-047.md) — When the page receives a previewPlantUmlIncludeResult, it SHALL give the answer to the request that has the same edit id and SHALL ignore an answer whose edit id matches no waiting request or repeats an answered one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-048 — A host refusal of an include reaches the diagram as its reason](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-048.md) — When the host refuses an include, the page SHALL give the engine the host's reason exactly once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-049 — Malformed include requests are ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-049.md) — When the bundle dispatches a file request without a respond function, a request object or a string path, the page SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-050 — The host accepts only well-formed include requests](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-050.md) — When the host receives a previewPlantUmlInclude message, it SHALL accept it only with a file name that is not blank and at most 4096 characters, a from that is null or a non-empty string of at most 4096 characters, and a non-empty bounded edit id.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-051 — Include requests are handled for the current document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-051.md) — When the host receives a previewPlantUmlInclude message whose document id is that of the preview's current document, it SHALL handle it even if the page is one render behind, and SHALL drop it for any other document or a closed preview.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-052 — The host answers an include request with the same edit id](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-052.md) — When the host handles an include request, it SHALL answer with previewPlantUmlIncludeResult carrying the request's edit id: ok with the file's real path as id and its text, or not ok with a reason.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-053 — Served and missing include files are remembered for watching](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-053.md) — When the host serves an include file, or refuses one that does not exist inside the allowed folders, it SHALL remember the canonical path of that file for watching.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-054 — Empty names, URLs and library names are never read](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-054.md) — When an include request has an empty name after trimming, a URL, or a library name in angle brackets, the host SHALL refuse it without reading the disk.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-055 — A forged relative from is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-055.md) — When an include request carries a from that is not an absolute path, the host SHALL refuse it with the reason PlantUML file followed by the name and could not be read.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-056 — Includes resolve next to the including file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-056.md) — When the host resolves an include, it SHALL resolve a top-level include next to the previewed document and a nested include next to the including file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-057 — The trust state sets the folders an include may read](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-057.md) — When the workspace is trusted, the host SHALL serve include files from the workspace, and in Restricted Mode only from the document's folder and below.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-058 — A missing include file is refused and watched](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-058.md) — When an include names a file that does not exist inside the allowed folders, the host SHALL refuse it with the reason PlantUML file not found followed by the name and report the missing path for watching.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-059 — An include file over 5 MiB is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-059.md) — When an include file is larger than 5 MiB, the host SHALL refuse it with the reason that the file is larger than the 5 MiB preview limit.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-060 — A symlink leaving the allowed folders is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-060.md) — When an include file is a symbolic link whose target lies outside the allowed folders, the host SHALL refuse it with the reason that the file is outside the folders the preview reads.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-061 — Includes nest at most 8 files deep](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-061.md) — When a built-in diagram includes files nested more than 8 deep, the page SHALL refuse the ninth level with the reason that the file is nested deeper than 8 includes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-062 — A diagram includes at most 64 files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-062.md) — When a built-in diagram asks for a 65th distinct include, the page SHALL refuse it with the reason that a diagram includes at most 64 files.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-063 — A diagram and its includes hold at most 1 MiB of text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-063.md) — When the text of a built-in diagram plus its included files would exceed 1 MiB, the page SHALL refuse the include that crosses the limit with the reason that the diagram with its included files exceeds the 1 MiB preview limit.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-064 — An include cycle stops with a message](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-064.md) — When an included file includes one of its ancestors, including the diagram's own .puml file, the page SHALL stop with the reason that the file includes itself (an include cycle) instead of looping.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-065 — A changed include file tells the page](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-065.md) — When a file that the built-in engine read, or asked for in vain inside the allowed folders, changes on disk, the host SHALL send previewPlantUmlIncludesChanged to the page, after an open block editor closes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-066 — The include watch holds at most 1024 files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-066.md) — When more than 1024 include files have been remembered, the host SHALL forget the oldest.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-067 — The include watch is cleared when the preview follows another document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-067.md) — When the preview follows another document, the host SHALL forget all remembered include files.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-068 — A {uml} or body-less {plantuml} path renders the file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-068.md) — When a {uml} directive or a {plantuml} directive without a body names a file, the extension SHALL render the diagram stored in that file, using the file text as the diagram and as the expandable source and recording the file name on the diagram element.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-069 — A diagram file is a dependency of the render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-069.md) — When a {uml} or body-less {plantuml} file is read, the extension SHALL record it as a dependency of the render so that a change of the file renders the preview again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-070 — An unreadable diagram file shows its refusal](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-070.md) — When the file named by a {uml} or body-less {plantuml} directive is outside the allowed folders, is an absolute path or a URL, or is larger than 5 MiB, the extension SHALL show the refusal message in place of the diagram and report one warning for the line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-071 — A missing diagram file is reported and watched](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-071.md) — When the file named by a {uml} or body-less {plantuml} directive does not exist inside the allowed folders, the extension SHALL show PlantUML file not found followed by the path in place of the diagram, report one warning, and watch the missing path so the diagram appears once the file is created.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-072 — An exhausted include budget stops diagram files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-072.md) — When the include budget of a render is exhausted, the extension SHALL show that the file was not read because the include budget of this render is exhausted in place of each remaining {uml} or body-less {plantuml} diagram, with one budget warning for the render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-073 — A {uml} directive without file or body says so](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-073.md) — When a {uml} directive has neither a file path nor a body, the extension SHALL show The {uml} directive needs a diagram file path or a diagram body. in place of the diagram and report a warning.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-074 — Nested diagrams resolve includes next to their own file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-074.md) — When a PlantUML diagram comes from an included document or from a {uml} file, the extension SHALL mark it with data-plantuml-base so its !include lines resolve next to that file and not next to the previewed document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-075 — Changing a PlantUML setting renders the open document again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-075.md) — When any markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml setting changes, the extension SHALL read the settings again for every open preview and render the open document again without reopening the preview.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-076 — The useJar setting is contributed with an explanation](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-076.md) — When the extension is installed, it SHALL contribute the boolean setting markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.useJar with default false, order 79 and a Markdown description of the engine choice.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-077 — The jarPath setting is contributed with an explanation](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-077.md) — When the extension is installed, it SHALL contribute the string setting markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath with an empty default, order 80 and a description saying it is used only when useJar is on, relative to the workspace folder, and empty for the plantuml command.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-078 — The PlantUML settings form their own category](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-078.md) — When the Settings editor lists the extension's settings, the extension SHALL group the two PlantUML settings in a category titled PlantUML at position 5.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-079 — The built-in engine is pinned to an exact version](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-079.md) — When the extension is packaged, it SHALL depend on @plantuml/core at one exact version without a range.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-080 — The built-in engine bundle and licence are packaged](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-080.md) — When the extension is built, it SHALL produce out/bundle/plantumlPreview.js from src/page/modules/plantumlPreview.ts and copy the engine's LICENSE to out/bundle/plantuml/LICENSE.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-081 — PlantUML pictures are contained in the content width](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-081.md) — When a PlantUML picture is wider than the content column, the extension SHALL scale it down to the column width keeping its proportions.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-082 — PlantUML messages use the error style](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-082.md) — When a PlantUML diagram shows a message, the extension SHALL style it in the theme error colour in italics.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-083 — The PlantUML source disclosure is styled like Mermaid's](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-083.md) — When a PlantUML figure shows its source disclosure, the extension SHALL style the summary in the description colour with a pointer cursor and a smaller font and leave a margin above the details.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-084 — A configured JAR is run with java](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-084.md) — When useJar is true in a trusted workspace and jarPath is not empty, the extension SHALL render each PlantUML diagram by running java with the arguments -jar, the resolved JAR path, -pipe and -tsvg.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-085 — Without a JAR the plantuml command is run](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-085.md) — When useJar is true in a trusted workspace and jarPath is empty, the extension SHALL render each PlantUML diagram by running the plantuml command with the arguments -pipe and -tsvg.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-086 — The JAR pipeline takes the SVG from the process output](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-086.md) — When the JAR pipeline runs a process for a diagram, the extension SHALL take as the picture the output from the first svg start tag to the last svg end tag.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-087 — jarPath is read as a trimmed string](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-087.md) — When the extension reads markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath, it SHALL trim the value, and SHALL read a value that is not a string as empty.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-088 — A relative jarPath is resolved from the workspace folder](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-088.md) — When jarPath is a relative path, the extension SHALL resolve it from the workspace folder, and SHALL use an absolute path as it is.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-089 — A jarPath that does not exist is reported on every diagram](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-089.md) — When the resolved JAR path does not exist, the extension SHALL show The PlantUML JAR could not be found followed by the path on every PlantUML diagram with state error, and SHALL start no process.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-090 — A jarPath that is a directory is reported](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-090.md) — When the resolved JAR path exists but is not a file, the extension SHALL show The PlantUML JAR path is not a file followed by the path on every PlantUML diagram with state error, and SHALL start no process.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-091 — Restricted Mode disables JAR rendering](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-091.md) — When useJar is true in an untrusted workspace, the extension SHALL start no process and SHALL show PlantUML preview is disabled in an untrusted workspace. on every PlantUML diagram with state unavailable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-092 — A missing plantuml command is reported](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-092.md) — When the plantuml command is not found, the extension SHALL show PlantUML executable "plantuml" was not found on PATH. Set markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath to a valid JAR path. on the diagram with state unavailable, and keep the source.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-093 — A missing Java is reported like a missing command](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-093.md) — When useJar is true and jarPath is set but java cannot be started because it is not found, the extension SHALL show PlantUML executable "java" was not found on PATH. Set markdownOkfSchemaStudio.plantuml.jarPath to a valid JAR path. on the diagram with state unavailable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-094 — A failing PlantUML process shows its exit and error output](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-094.md) — When a PlantUML process exits with a non-zero code or a signal, the extension SHALL show PlantUML exited with code N or signal S, followed by a colon and the process's error output or PlantUML returned no diagnostic., on the diagram with state error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-095 — Output without an SVG is reported](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-095.md) — When a PlantUML process exits successfully but its output holds no complete SVG, the extension SHALL show PlantUML did not return SVG output. on the diagram with state error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-096 — A process that cannot be spawned is reported](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-096.md) — When starting the PlantUML process throws, the extension SHALL report the failure on the diagram like any other failure, with the error text, and state error, or the missing-executable message when the error is a missing command.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-097 — Process error text is capped at 64 KiB](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-097.md) — When a failed PlantUML process writes more than 64 KiB of error output, the extension SHALL keep the first 64 KiB and add \[stderr truncated at 64 KiB\] to the message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-098 — The JAR pipeline refuses a source over 1 MiB](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-098.md) — When a PlantUML diagram text is longer than 1 MiB, the extension SHALL show PlantUML source exceeds the 1 MiB preview limit. on the diagram with state error, without starting a process.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-099 — The JAR pipeline stops an output over 8 MiB](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-099.md) — When a PlantUML process writes more than 8 MiB to its standard output, the extension SHALL kill the process and show PlantUML SVG output exceeds the 8 MiB preview limit. on the diagram with state error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-100 — A JAR render stops after 30 seconds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-100.md) — When a PlantUML process runs for more than 30 seconds, the extension SHALL kill the whole process group and show PlantUML did not finish within 30 s. on the diagram with state error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-101 — Cancelling a render stops the PlantUML process group](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-101.md) — When a render is cancelled by a newer render stage or the closing of the preview, the extension SHALL send SIGTERM to the whole process group of the PlantUML process on POSIX, falling back to the direct child.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-102 — A process that ignores its input becomes a message](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-102.md) — When a PlantUML process exits before reading its input or its standard input reports an error, the extension SHALL report the failure on the diagram as a normal message and SHALL NOT raise an uncaught exception in the extension host.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-103 — A render settles exactly once](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-103.md) — When close, error and timeout events of a PlantUML process arrive together, the extension SHALL settle the render exactly once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-104 — The JAR pipeline starts one process per diagram](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-104.md) — When a document has several PlantUML diagrams and useJar is true in a trusted workspace, the extension SHALL start one process per diagram, all at once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-105 — JAR results are matched to diagrams in document order](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-105.md) — When the JAR pipeline has several results, the extension SHALL match each result to its diagram in document order with the diagram's source line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-106 — JAR results replace the diagrams in the open preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-106.md) — When the JAR pipeline finishes a diagram, the extension SHALL replace the content of its diagram element with an image of alt text "PlantUML diagram" and a data URI of the SVG and state rendered, or with a paragraph of class myst-plantuml-error holding the message and the state error or unavailable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-107 — Each JAR failure is also a status-line warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-107.md) — When a JAR diagram fails or is blocked, the extension SHALL report a warning with the code plantuml-render and the document path, in addition to the message on the diagram.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-108 — JAR results reach a ready page in place](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-108.md) — When incremental updates are on, the page is ready for the render stage, the status lines fit a patch and a content patch can be planned, the extension SHALL send the JAR results as a content patch without reloading the page, and otherwise SHALL set the full page HTML.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-109 — Results of an older render stage are dropped](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-109.md) — When JAR results belong to a render stage that is no longer the current one, the extension SHALL drop them.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-110 — JAR results wait for an open block edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-110.md) — When a block editor is open, the extension SHALL hold the JAR results and apply them after the edit ends instead of closing the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-111 — A working JAR draws a diagram as a loaded picture](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-111.md) — When a PlantUML installation works, the extension SHALL draw a diagram as a loaded picture without an error and keep its expandable source.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-112 — Unsupported directives never reach the engine or the host](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-112.md) — When a built-in diagram has a line starting with !includeurl, !includedef or !import, an include of a URL or of a library name in angle brackets, or a !theme with from, the page SHALL NOT run the engine and SHALL NOT ask the host for a file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-113 — Include silence and malformed answers reach the diagram as reasons](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-113.md) — When the host does not answer an include within 10 seconds or sends an answer that is not well formed, the page SHALL give the engine a failure reason exactly once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-114 — A non-string from is sent as null](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-114.md) — When an include request from the bundle has a from that is not a string, the page SHALL send from as null.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-115 — A theme switch between light and dark redraws built-in diagrams](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-115.md) — When a theme change switches the preview between a light and a dark background, the page SHALL draw every built-in diagram again in the other variant.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-116 — A late Mermaid error for a replaced key is not shown](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-116.md) — When Mermaid fails a drawing after the node was planned for another key, the page SHALL NOT show an error for the replaced key.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-117 — One failing JAR diagram does not affect the others](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-117.md) — When one of several JAR diagrams fails, the extension SHALL still render the other diagrams.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-118 — A cancelled JAR render reports the cancellation](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-118.md) — When a render is cancelled, the extension SHALL report PlantUML rendering was canceled. on the diagram.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-119 — PlantUML pictures are centred](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-119.md) — When a PlantUML picture is shown, the extension SHALL centre it in the content column.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-120 — The JAR pipeline feeds the text on stdin in the workspace folder](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-120.md) — When the JAR pipeline runs a process for a diagram, the extension SHALL write the diagram text to its standard input and run the process in the workspace folder.
